name: Leni Loud
source:
Leni is my second biggest sister! Which is a different way of saying she's the second eldest in the family.

If I could list the great things about Leni it would be her sense of fashion, her lockpicking skills (No one knows where she got those!) her woodworking, and most importantly, her big heart. The fashion area is where she really shines though. She loves clothes, and helping others look their best in them too! She's the reason [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]I[/url] wear orange, she says it brings out my eyes and compliments my hair!

Leni is also the sweetest of all my sisters. I´d say she's probably the most liked in the family next to [url=https://vndb.org/c151351]Lily[/url]!

The problem is, my sister Leni is... well... okay let's just get it out there. She's very ditzy, kind of an airhead. She walks into walls when she's not paying attention, and has failed her driver's license test like 16 times! You have to be careful what you say to her or she'll sometimes take it too literally. She currently works at the mall, and her favorite phrase is "[i]O M Gosh![/i]".

[In game description]
